_draft: Gift designs: names, lines and art briefs are DRAFTS (12 Oct 2026). Gifts carry their own designs and are not tied to a series; `story` only links to a book that shares the idea. Every design is one small, quiet Pim scene. Postcards and greeting cards: one design per pack of 10, no mixed packs.

mug.name: Cocoa Cat
mug.line: A witch-hat cat and a warm cup of cocoa.
mug.about: A black cat with big round eyes in a tiny witch hat, curled around a steaming cup of cocoa, with one small pumpkin beside it.

mug.name: Cocoa Ghost
mug.line: A small dog in a ghost sheet, cocoa at the ready.
mug.about: A small brown dog dressed as a friendly ghost in a white sheet with round eye holes, sitting beside a steaming cup of cocoa.

mug.name: Pumpkin Cats
mug.line: Three cats peek over one big pumpkin.
mug.about: Three cats peeking over the edge of one big orange pumpkin: a ginger cat, a black cat and a grey tabby.

mug.name: Pumpkin Dogs
mug.line: Three dogs peek over one big pumpkin.
mug.about: Three dogs peeking over the edge of one big orange pumpkin: a long dachshund, a small white dog and a floppy-eared brown dog.

tote.name: Moon Cat
tote.line: A tall cat in a witch hat under the crescent moon.
tote.about: A tall black cat in a pointy witch hat sitting under a big crescent moon, with three small bats and a few stars.

tote.name: Lantern Dog
tote.line: A mummy dog walks proudly with a pumpkin lantern.
tote.about: A floppy-eared dog dressed as a mummy in white bandages, walking proudly with a small pumpkin lantern.

tote.name: Cat Parade
tote.line: Four cats in costume, in a row under the moon.
tote.about: Four cats of different colours in simple witch and mummy costumes sitting in a row under a crescent moon, with small bats above.

tote.name: Dog Parade
tote.line: Four dogs in costume, out with their pumpkin buckets.
tote.about: Four dogs of different sizes in simple ghost, mummy and witch-hat costumes walking together with small pumpkin buckets.

tote.name: Broom Cat
tote.line: A white cat on a broom, flying past the moon.
tote.about: A white cat in an orange witch hat flying past a big round moon on a broom, small stars around.

tote.name: Ghost Pup
tote.line: A little ghost dog floats past with a lantern.
tote.about: A small dog in a white ghost sheet floating among the stars, holding a pumpkin lantern.

tote.name: Cat Choir
tote.line: Three cats sing to the moon on the garden wall.
tote.about: Three cats sitting on a garden wall, singing at a big orange moon, with small bats around.

tote.name: Lantern Patrol
tote.line: Three dogs walk the night with their lanterns.
tote.about: Three dogs in simple costumes walking in a row with glowing pumpkin lanterns through the night.

postcards.name: Moonlight Cat
postcards.line: A ginger cat on a stone wall in the moonlight.
postcards.about: A ginger cat in a striped witch hat sitting on a low stone wall in the moonlight, three small pumpkins at its feet, a crescent moon and small stars.

postcards.name: Pumpkin Pup
postcards.line: A small dog in a pumpkin costume, deep in the leaves.
postcards.about: A small dog in a pumpkin costume sitting in a pile of autumn leaves, a crescent moon behind it.

postcards.name: Pumpkin Patch Cats
postcards.line: A cat family watches the bats over the pumpkin patch.
postcards.about: A family of cats of different colours watching small bats fly over a pumpkin patch at dusk.

postcards.name: Trick-or-Treat Dogs
postcards.about: A family of dogs of different colours in costumes trick-or-treating along a small path past a smiling pumpkin.

cards.name: Boo Cat
cards.line: A white cat in a ghost sheet with a paper bat.
cards.about: A white cat in a little ghost sheet holding a small paper bat on a string, smiling, with one small pumpkin beside it.

cards.name: Witch Hat Dog
cards.line: A spotted dog in a witch hat with a pumpkin lantern.
cards.about: A spotted dog in a little witch hat holding a small pumpkin lantern, sitting among a few autumn leaves.

cards.about: Two kittens in tiny pumpkin hats sitting close together under a crescent moon.

_halloween: DRAFT (12 Oct 2026): the Halloween line of cats and dogs, four designs per product (one cat, one dog, many cats, many dogs). `placeholder: true` = no photos yet (a placeholder picture, cannot be ordered). `prompt` points to scripts/catalog/prompts.json; `about` is the picture brief, `line` the one-line card text. No printed words unless John writes them in `words`. Tote bags: 8 designs, each on one colour (4 undyed, 4 black). The older Pim designs were removed on 13 Oct 2026 (John); their URLs 301 to the category pages (vercel.json).
